# Ticket 01

## Title

Calculate the DX Coil Height

## Description

As we enter in the Cooling Package (e.g. R-454B FW 43 ) - the system will run to Calculations and get the starting values.
The DX Coil Height is empty.
What we want to happen is:
- The Cooling Circuits are populated
- Then we sum the height for each Circuit to make the value that is to appear in the DX Coil Information.
- For exmaple We have 3 circuits, each with a height of 7.5
- so 7.5 + 7.5 + 7.5 = 22.5
- and should the user alter the Circuit Height - the form should react to this edit - resum all heights and update the Height field in DX Coil Information

interpreterResult.requirementSummary: When a Cooling Package is entered and calculations are run, the system must populate the Cooling Circuits, sum the heights of all circuits to set the DX Coil Height in the DX Coil Information, and automatically recompute and update this sum whenever a user edits any Circuit Height.
businessRules: After entering a Cooling Package and initiating calculations, the Cooling Circuits are populated.
The DX Coil Height field is initially empty and must be set to the sum of the heights of all Cooling Circuits.
If a user alters the height of any Cooling Circuit, the system must recalculate the total of all Circuit heights and update the DX Coil Height field in the DX Coil Information.
developerConsiderations: Implement dynamic recalculation of the DX Coil Height whenever a Circuit Height value changes.
Ensure the sum includes all currently populated Cooling Circuits.
Treat the DX Coil Height field as a system‑generated value that updates automatically (read‑only from the user's perspective).
ambiguities: The unit of measurement for Circuit Height and DX Coil Height is not specified.
Rounding or precision requirements for the summed DX Coil Height are not defined.
Validation rules for acceptable Circuit Height values (e.g., non‑negative, maximum) are not provided.
Behavior when Cooling Circuits are added or removed after the initial calculation is not described.
Whether the DX Coil Height field should be editable by the user or strictly read‑only is unclear.
